audit_items.proof_trace: Both `syncDiscordRoles` and `syncDiscordNickname` wrap their entire `fetch` call in try/catch; any exception (network, malformed uid, etc.) is caught and logged, never rethrown. All callers await these functions, so no unhandled promise rejection can escape to the process level. `JSON.stringify({ discord_uid: discordUid })` never throws for string/null/undefined values, and the malformed uid only appears in the JSON body, not the URL.
